model_version_policy: OpenRouter alias; record returned model/provider per call. Stop if unavailable or materially changed; no silent substitution.
structured_output_mode: response_format.type=json_schema; json_schema.strict=true; client-side JSON Schema validation
retry_policy: Stop on timeout, HTTP/provider error, refusal, incomplete output or schema failure. Preserve raw response and any usage; no paid retry or repair without separate approval.
temperature_caveat: Temperature zero reduces sampling variation but does not guarantee identical responses or pin provider weights.
